summary: Iteration 3 (Swiggy CTAs added alongside every WhatsApp CTA) tested end-to-end via Playwright. 37/37 UI assertions passed across desktop + mobile. No console errors. All previously-passing flows still work.
critical_code_review_comments: SignatureCard uses inline `ml-2` on the Swiggy button — on very narrow mobile widths the WhatsApp + Swiggy buttons on a Signature card may wrap awkwardly; consider a `flex flex-wrap gap-2` wrapper. Not a blocker.
Catalogue product cards use `href={SITE.swiggy}` on all 91 cards which is fine, but a comment/note would help future maintainers know that Swiggy has a single restaurant menu (no per-item deep-link).
